arguments.query: SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT 'pending_booking' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE status <> 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'booking_id',c.booking_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status <> 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status <> 'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache

SELECT 'config' AS kind,service AS id,value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled',b.booking_id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'charge_state',c.state,'key',c.idempotency_key,'refund',r.amount_cents,'hold',h.booking_id,'checkin',k.booking_id,'cancel_event',e.event_id) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN checkins k USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'incomplete',b.booking_id,json_object('status',b.status,'hold',h.booking_id,'checkin',k.booking_id,'charges',(SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'captured',(SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN checkins k USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (h.booking_id IS NULL OR k.booking_id IS NULL OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')<>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'recent_log',CAST(id AS TEXT),json_object('service',service,'path',path,'status',status,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30)

SELECT 'recent_booking' AS kind,b.booking_id AS id,json_object('flight_id',b.flight_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'confirmed_at',b.confirmed_at,'charge',c.amount_cents) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.confirmed_at>=15 UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'amount',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights
